author: musho7-dev
subject: Planets: picture tiles, info panel, view before unlocking
body:
- Planet tiles show a small drawn picture of each planet (sky, sun or
  ringed planet with stars, ridge, ground layers), padlock when locked
- Info panel for the shown planet: name, description, and bars for
  gravity, grip, hills and coin bonus
- Tapping a locked planet previews it (background switches to that
  planet) with an "Unlock ... for N coins?" BUY / Cancel bar instead
  of unlocking instantly
